verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an MCP server, a CLI that operates payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores and reports with a single token, and individual API flows. None of it describes batch or bulk operations that act on many items in a single action. Running single-item CLI or API calls in a loop would be a user-side workaround, not a documented bulk capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
